description: Magma computer algebra language support for Pulsar: Tree-sitter highlighting, folding, indentation and symbols, plus snippets

indentDocstring.title: Indent intrinsic docstrings
indentDocstring.description: Indent the `{...}` documentation string one level under the `intrinsic` line, instead of leaving it flush with it. Applies to the Tree-sitter grammar.
